purpose: Independent re-verification of the first-public timestamps of the four events named as spot checks in reports/m2-step3-acceptance-review.json, against a source that none of the original per-event evidence used. Each event's packet already cross-checks the wire-displayed stamp against the SEC filing's own acceptance time; this adds a third, separate source per event.
selection_rule: Fixed before looking at any outcome and applied mechanically: of the 57 events whose session_20_close_return is non-null (the audit's own 'complete' definition), the two latest by published_at in each release-timing class -- premarket: LNSR 2025-05-08 07:00 ET and ACHV 2025-05-13 07:30 ET; after_hours: VSAT 2025-05-20 16:05 ET and OKTA 2025-05-27 16:01 ET.

independent_sources: Company investor-relations newsroom page title: 'LENSAR Reports First Quarter 2025 Results and Provides Business Update - Thu, 05/08/2025 - 07:00' (https://ir.lensar.com/news-releases/news-release-details/lensar-reports-first-quarter-2025-results-and-provides-business)
Yahoo Finance syndication copy, whose URL carries a UTC creation stamp of 11:00:00.305 = 07:00:00 EDT (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/lensar-reports-first-quarter-2025-110000305.html)
checks.result: AGREES -- 07:00 ET on 2025-05-08, ahead of the 07:15:09 SEC acceptance.
checks.note: The same-day Form 8-K/A (accepted 16:01:08 ET) corrects narrative errors in this release; it does not move the first public time.

checks.result: AGREES -- 07:30 ET on 2025-05-13, ahead of the 07:34:08 SEC acceptance.
checks.note: SEC's filing-index page (07:34:08 ET) governs over the submissions JSON clock for this filer, which runs ahead by the UTC offset.

independent_sources: Yahoo Finance syndication copy, whose URL carries a UTC creation stamp of 20:05:00.883 = 16:05:00 EDT (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/viasat-releases-fourth-quarter-fiscal-200500883.html)

Company investor-relations release page (https://investors.viasat.com/news-releases/news-release-details/viasat-releases-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial) confirms the date, 2025-05-20; it displays no time of day, so it does not corroborate the minute.
checks.result: AGREES -- 16:05 ET on 2025-05-20, 29 seconds before the SEC acceptance.
checks.note: The release is a short notice that the results are in a shareholder letter posted to the investor site at the same time (the 8-K's Exhibit 99.2).

independent_sources: Yahoo Finance syndication copy, whose URL carries a UTC creation stamp of 20:01:00.906 = 16:01:00 EDT (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/okta-announces-first-quarter-fiscal-200100906.html)

Company investor-relations release page (https://investor.okta.com/news-and-events/news-releases/news-details/2025/Okta-Announces-First-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx) confirms the date, 2025-05-27; it displays no time of day, so it does not corroborate the minute.
checks.result: AGREES -- 16:01 ET on 2025-05-27, ahead of the 16:06:33 SEC acceptance.
checks.note: SEC's filing-index page (16:06:33 ET) governs over the submissions JSON clock for this filer, which runs ahead by the UTC offset.

limits: Yahoo Finance's syndication URLs embed a UTC HHMMSSmmm creation stamp; reading it as the release time is an inference from the URL pattern, used only as a corroborating signal. It agreed with the wire stamp everywhere it was looked at in this project (HURN, COLL, PAYO and KLC in earlier batches, and the three above).
For VSAT and OKTA the company pages show only the date, so the minute is corroborated by one secondary source, not two.
A re-verification of four events, not of all 60: every event's packet carries its own wire-versus-SEC-acceptance cross-check.
not_a_claim: Not a verification that any first-public time is the earliest possible: absence of an earlier disclosure is still a residual gap each packet states.
